messages:
marta_cs: Heads-up: Emberfield wants to onboard a tailored 14B summarizer for clinical notes. They require PHI redaction, KMS/HSM key wrapping, SOC2 evidence, and a p95 <=200ms SLA. Renewal in two weeks, so this is high priority.
leah_pm: copy 1. please add exact security checklist and their expected qps. we'll note renewal risk in account health.
devon_se: Need model spec + sample prompt bank and eval set. Is this private (VPC) or on-prem? HSM usually implies private.
marta_cs: Customer brief: "Onboard Ember-14B summarizer; PHI token redaction with auditable logs; KMS/HSM key wrapping; SOC2 attestation; p95 <=200ms for short summaries; steady 50 qps with 200 qps bursts; canary rollouts + quick rollback." Also asked for enablement next week.
sanjay_infra: PHI+HSM -> recommend Private. Quick sizing: 4xA10G with KV cache for 50 qps steady; autoscale for bursts. I'll validate memory/throughput and provide cost delta.
deploy-bot: deploy request created: DR-8879. CI checks pending. https://deploys.internal/DR-8879
leah_pm: We should run a safety eval on their labeled dataset (redaction edge cases, hallucination on medical prompts). @marta_cs can you get the labeled eval set and label schema by EOD Wed?
marta_cs: I'll request eval set, prompt bank, and any preferred SLA language today.
devon_se: Proposed eval plan: (1) redaction coverage across entity types, (2) hallucination/regression tests on clinical/legal prompts, (3) latency under sustained burst. Quick harness snippet: ```python
for p in prompts:
    r = client.generate(model="ember-14b-v1", prompt=p)
    check_redaction(r)
```
sanjay_infra: I'll draft infra sizing + provisioning lead time for HSM keys and estimate cost impact. ETA tomorrow noon.
marta_cs: Action items: I) eval set & prompt bank (marta_cs) II) infra & cost estimate (sanjay_infra) III) safety eval harness (devon_se) IV) schedule enablement and own renewal (leah_pm).
leah_pm: Scheduling 30-min kickoff Tue 11am. Inviting Emberfield CSM + security lead + our security reviewer. Renewal owner: leah_pm.
marta_cs: Noted. I'll flag renewal risk in account health doc and brief the AM. :white_check_mark:
